road disappears beneath our feet...\n\nAnd even the strongest among us begin to question...\n\nWhy must we continue?\n\n[PAUSE — 3 seconds]\n\nLook at the history of humanity.\n\nWe have stood beneath burning skies.\n\nWe have watched kingdoms fall, cities disappear, and generations vanish into the silence of time.\n\nWe have buried those we loved.\n\nWe have fought wars we never wanted.\n\nWe have faced nights so dark...\n\nThat morning itself seemed impossible.\n\n[VOICE DEEPENS]\n\nAnd yet...\n\nWe are still here.\n\n[PAUSE — 2 seconds]\n\nDo you understand what that means?\n\nAfter every disaster...\n\nAfter every betrayal...\n\nAfter every wound that should have broken us...\n\nHumanity rises.\n\nNot because we are invincible.\n\nNot because we never feel pain.\n\nBut because somewhere, deep within the human soul...\n\nThere exists a fire that refuses to die.\n\n[ORCHESTRA BEGINS TO BUILD — STRINGS RISE]\n\nThey can take our possessions.\n\nThey can destroy our cities.\n\nThey can silence our voices.\n\nThey can make us kneel before the weight of the world.\n\nBut there is one thing they cannot take...\n\nUnless we surrender it ourselves.\n\nOur will.\n\nOur courage.\n\nOur capacity to begin again.\n\n[PAUSE — 3 seconds]\n\nYou see...\n\nStrength is not the absence of fear.\n\nStrength is walking forward while your hands are trembling.\n\nIt is standing beside someone when the whole world has abandoned them.\n\nIt is choosing kindness when hatred would be easier.\n\nIt is waking up tomorrow...\n\nAfter yesterday tried to destroy you.\n\n[DRUMS BEGIN — SLOW, HEAVY, DISTANT]\n\nAnd perhaps...\n\nThat is the greatest miracle of being human.\n\nWe are fragile creatures.\n\nOur bodies can break.\n\nOur hearts can shatter.\n\nOur lives can end in a single moment.\n\nAnd yet we dream of eternity.\n\nWe build even when we know everything may one day fall.\n\nWe love even when we know that loss is waiting somewhere in the future.\n\nWe plant trees beneath whose shadows we may never sit.\n\nWe write words that generations we will never meet may one day read.\n\n[VOICE RISES — MORE PASSIONATE]\n\nWHY?\n\nBecause we believe that tomorrow can be better than today.\n\nBecause somewhere inside us...\n\nHope is stronger than despair.\n\nBecause we were never meant to simply exist.\n\nWe were meant to create.\n\nTo discover.\n\nTo love.\n\nTo struggle.\n\nTo rise.\n\n[ORCHESTRA EXPLODES — MASSIVE CHOIR AND CINEMATIC PERCUSSION]\n\nSo let the storms come!\n\nLet the mountains stand before us!\n\nLet the darkness stretch across the horizon!\n\nWe have been afraid before.\n\nWe have fallen before.\n\nWe have lost before.\n\nBUT WE HAVE ALSO RISEN!\n\nAnd we shall rise again!\n\n[PAUSE — MUSIC DROPS TO A LOW, DEEP STRING NOTE]\n\nRemember this...\n\nA human being is not measured by how many times life allows them to stand...\n\nBut by the courage they find when life gives them every reason to fall.\n\n[FINAL BUILD — DEEP MALE VOICE, SLOW AND COMMANDING]\n\nWe are more than our wounds.\n\nMore than our failures.\n\nMore than the darkness that surrounds us.\n\nWe are the dreamers who challenge the impossible.\n\nThe survivors who carry hope through the ruins.\n\nThe ordinary people who perform extraordinary acts when the moment demands it.\n\nAnd as long as one heart still beats...\n\nAs long as one voice dares to speak...\n\nAs long as one soul refuses to surrender...\n\nTHE HUMAN SPIRIT SHALL NEVER BE DEFEATED.\n\n[LONG SILENCE — 2 seconds]\n\nWe were not born to surrender.\n\nWE WERE NOTE]\n\nRemember this...\n\nA human being is not measured by how many times life allows them to stand...\n\nBut by the courage they find when life gives them every reason to fall.\n\n[FINAL BUILD — DEEP MALE VOICE, SLOW AND COMMANDING]\n\nWe are more than our wounds.\n\nMore than our failures.\n\nMore than the darkness that surrounds us.\n\nWe are the dreamers who challenge the impossible.\n\nThe survivors who carry hope through the ruins.\n\nThe ordinary people who perform extraordinary acts when the moment demands it.\n\nAnd as long as one heart still beats...\n\nAs long as one voice dares to speak...\n\nAs long as one soul refuses to surrender...\n\nTHE HUMAN SPIRIT SHALL NEVER BE DEFEATED.\n\n[LONG SILENCE — 2 seconds]\n\nWe were not born to surrender.\n\nWE WERE BORN TO RISE.\n\n[FINAL ORCHESTRAL IMPACT — CHOIR SUSTAINS, THEN COMPLETE SILENCE.]f7:T1f4a,TERE NAAL SUKOON ❤️\n\nPunjabi-Hindi Romantic Duet\n\n[INTRO – FEMALE SOFT VOCALS]\n\nहम्म... हम्म...\nओ सजना... ओ माहिया...\nरातां च तेरी याद सतावे,\nदिल मेरा तैनूं बुलावे।\nचन्न वी तेरा नाम पुकारे,\nदिल तैनूं हर पल निहारे।\n\n[VERSE 1 – MALE PUNJABI VOCALS]\n\nजदों पहली वारी तैनूं वेखया,\nदिल ने इशारा कीता सी,\nतेरी अखियां दे समुंदर अंदर,\nमैं अपना जहां बना लिता सी।\n\nतेरी हंसी मेरा संगीत बने,\nतेरी बातें मेरा प्यार,\nतेरे बिना अधूरी लगदी,\nमेरी जिंदगी दी हर बहार।\n\nतेरे नाल मैं सपने सजावां,\nतेरे नाल हर पल बितावां,\nदुनिया भुल के सजना मैं,\nबस तैनूं अपना बनावां।\n\n[VERSE 2 – FEMALE HINDI VOCALS]\n\nजब पहली बार तुम्हें देखा,\nकुछ अपना सा एहसास हुआ,\nजैसे बरसों से ढूंढ रही थी,\nवो सपना मेरे पास हुआ।\n\nतेरी आंखों में बातें हैं,\nजो लफ्जों में कह पाऊं ना,\nतेरे दिल की धड़कन सुनकर,\nखुद को तुमसे छुपाऊं ना।\n\nतेरी बाहों में शाम गुजारूं,\nतेरे संग सुबह का नूर मिले,\nमेरी छोटी सी दुनिया को,\nतेरे प्यार का सुरूर मिले।\n\n[PRE-CHORUS – BOTH]\n\nMale:\nतू मेरी दुआवां दा जवाब बने,\nतू मेरे दिल दा ख्वाब बने।\n\nFemale:\nतू मेरी हर खुशी की वजह,\nतू ही मेरी जिंदगी की सुबह।\n\nBoth:\nचल साथ चलें इस दुनिया से दूर,\nजहां अपना प्यार हो भरपूर।\n\n[CHORUS – BOTH MALE AND FEMALE]\n\nतेरे नाल सुकून मिलदा ऐ,\nदिल नूं जुनून मिलदा ऐ,\nतू ही मेरी सुबह सजना,\nतू ही मेरा चन्न बनदा ऐ।\n\nतेरे नाल सुकून मिलदा ऐ,\nहर सपना हसीन लगदा ऐ,\nतू जो मेरे कोल होवे,\nहर मौसम रंगीन लगदा ऐ।\n\nओ माहिया... ओ सजना...\nतू ही मेरा प्यार ऐ,\nतेरे बिना इस दिल दा,\nकोई ना संसार ऐ।\n\n[VERSE 3 – MALE PUNJABI VOCALS]\n\nबारिश दी हर बूंद विच,\nतेरा चेहरा नज़र आवे,\nतेरे नाल बिताए पल सारे,\nदिल नूं रोज़ सतावें।\n\nइक छोटा जेहा घर बनावांगे,\nखिड़की कोल गुलाब लगावांगे,\nसुबह तेरे हाथ दी चाय पी के,\nसारे दुख भुलावांगे।\n\nना महलां दी कोई चाहत ऐ,\nना दौलत दा अरमान,\nतेरा साथ ही काफी सजना,\nतू ही मेरी पहचान।\n\n[VERSE 4 – FEMALE HINDI VOCALS]\n\nजब दुनिया मुझसे रूठेगी,\nतुम मेरा सहारा बनना,\nजब आंखों में आंसू होंगे,\nतुम मेरा किनारा बनना।\n\nकभी जो शाम उदास मिले,\nमुझे अपने पास बिठाना,\nमेरी खामोशी पढ़कर सजना,\nबिन बोले मुझे समझाना।\n\nतुमसे मिलकर जाना मैंने,\nप्यार सिर्फ कहानी नहीं,\nकिसी की खुशी में खुश होना,\nकोई छोटी निशानी नहीं।\n\n[DUET BRIDGE – CALL AND RESPONSE]\n\nMale:\nकी दस्सां तैनूं दिल दी गल्ल,\nतू ही मेरी सुबह, तू ही कल।\n\nFemale:\nकैसे कहूं मैं दिल की बात,\nतुमसे ही रोशन मेरी रात।\n\nMale:\nतेरे लई मैं गीत लिखांगा,\nहर दर्द नूं मैं जीत लवांगा।\n\nFemale:\nतेरी खुशी में खुशियां ढूंढूं,\nतेरे गम में तेरे साथ रहूं।\n\nBoth:\nइक वादा करिए आज सजना,\nप्यार निभावांगे सारी उमरां।\n\n[CHORUS – BOTH MALE AND FEMALE]\n\nतेरे नाल सुकून मिलदा ऐ,\nदिल नूं जुनून मिलदा ऐ,\nतू ही मेरी सुबह सजना,\nतू ही मेरा चन्न बनदा ऐ।\n\nतेरे नाल सुकून मिलदा ऐ,\nहर सपना हसीन लगदा ऐ,\nतू जो मेरे कोल होवे,\nहर मौसम रंगीन लगदा ऐ।\n\n[FINAL VERSE – SOFT DUET]\n\nMale:\nचन्न वी शर्मावे तैनूं वेख के,\nतारे वी मुस्कान छुपावण,\nफुल्लां दी खुशबू तेरे कोल आके,\nतेरा ही पैगाम सुनावण।\n\nFemale:\nमेरे दिल के हर कोने में,\nतेरी यादें रहती हैं,\nमेरी हर छोटी सी खुशी में,\nतेरी बातें बहती हैं।\n\nMale:\nना छड्डांगा तेरा हाथ कभी।\n\nFemale:\nना भूलूंगी तेरा साथ कभी।\n\nBoth:\nइक दूजे दे नाल रहांगे,\nप्यार दे दीप जलावांगे।\n\n[FINAL CHORUS – GRAND DUET]\n\nतेरे नाल सुकून मिलदा ऐ,\nदिल नूं जुनून मिलदा ऐ,\nतू ही मेरी सुबह सजना,\nतू ही मेरा चन्न बनदा ऐ।\n\nतेरे नाल हसना चाहवां,\nतेरे नाल जीना चाहवां,\nइस दिल दी हर धड़कन विच,\nतेरा ही नाम सजावां।\n\nतू मेरी मंजिल, तू मेरा रास्ता,\nतू ही मेरा प्यार दा वास्ता,\nरब कोलों बस इक्को अरदास,\nकदे ना टूटे अपना id="suno-advanced-ui" style="position: fixed; bottom: 20px; right: 20px; z-index: 2147483647; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Roboto, sans-serif; pointer-events: auto;">
    <div id="suno-main-btn" style="width: 56px; height: 56px; border-radius: 28px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgb(220, 53, 69), rgb(255, 69, 0)); border-width: medium; border-style: none; border-color: currentcolor; border-image: none; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(255, 69, 0, 0.4) 0px 4px 20px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; transition: 0.3s;">
      <svg id="suno-btn-icon" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="white" stroke-width="2.5">
      <rect x="6" y="4" width="12" height="16" rx="2" fill="white"></rect>
    </svg>
    </div>
    <div id="suno-panel" style="
      position: absolute;
      bottom: 70px;
      right: 0;
      width: 320px;
      background: #1a1a1a;
      border-radius: 16px;
      box-shadow: 0 8px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
      padding: 16px;
      display: none;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 12px;
      border: 1px solid #333;
    ">
      <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; padding-bottom: 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #333;">
        <strong style="color: #fff; font-size: 14px;">Suno Advanced Downloader</strong>
        <button id="suno-close-panel" style="background: none; border: none; color: #888; cursor: pointer; padding: 4px;">✕</button>
      </div>
      
      <div id="suno-status" style="color: rgb(251, 191, 36); font-size: 12px;">⏸ Paused / Stopped</div>
      
      <div id="suno-current-song" style="display: none;">
        <div style="font-size: 12px; color: #888;">Current Song</div>
        <div id="suno-song-title" style="color: #fff; font-weight: 500; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis;">-</div>
        <div id="suno-song-artist" style="color: #888; font-size: 11px;">-</div>
        <div id="suno-song-duration" style="color: #666; font-size: 11px;">-</div>
      </div>
      
      <div id="suno-recording-ui" style="display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px;">
        <div style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; color: #ff4500;">
          <span style="width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: #ff4500; animation: pulse 1s infinite;"></span>
          <span>Recording...</span>
          <span id="suno-rec-time" style="margin-left: auto; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;">0:39</span>
        </div>
        <div style="height: 4px; background: #333; border-radius: 2px; overflow: hidden;">
          <div id="suno-rec-progress" style="height: 100%; background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgb(255, 69, 0), rgb(255, 107, 53)); width: 21.7661%; transition: width 0.3s;"></div>
        </div>
      </div>
      
      <button id="suno-manual-record" style="padding: 12px; border-radius: 10px; border-width: medium; border-style: none; border-color: currentcolor; border-image: none; background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgb(255, 69, 0), rgb(255, 107, 53)); color: white; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.1s; display: none;">🎙️ Start Recording</button>
      
      <button id="suno-open-popup" style="
        padding: 10px;
        border-radius: 10px;
        border: 1px solid #333;
        background: transparent;
        color: #fff;
        cursor: pointer;
      ">Open Full Panel →</button>
      
      <div id="suno-queue-preview" style="display: block; max-height: 150px; overflow-y: auto;">
        <div style="font-size: 12px; color: #888; margin-bottom: 8px;">Queue (<span id="suno-queue-count">1</span>)</div>
        <div id="suno-queue-list">
          <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; padding: 6px 8px; background: #222; border-radius: 6px; margin-bottom: 4px; font-size: 11px;">
            <div style="flex: 1; min-width: 0;">
              <div style="color: #fff; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis;">Suno Song</div>
              <div style="color: #888; font-size: 10px;">Unknown Artist </div>
            </div>
            <span style="color: #ff4500; font-size: 10px; text-transform: capitalize;">recording</span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <style>
      @keyframes pulse { 0%, 100% { opacity: 1; } 50% { opacity: 0.4; } }
      #suno-main-btn:hover { transform: scale(1.05); box-shadow: 0 6px 28px rgba(255, 69, 0, 0.6); }
      #suno-main-btn:active { transform: scale(0.95); }
      #suno-manual-record:active { transform: scale(0.98); }
    </style>
